description: FOR IMMEDIATE RELEASE: In recognition of Labor Day, Drew Stokesbary is announcing the strong support his campaign for State Representative has received from Washington state’s construction industry. Stokesbary has been endorsed by the following groups: Associated Builders and Contractors of Western Washington Associated General Contractors of Washington Building Industry Association of Washington Master Builders Association … Continued
